product_results.description: SERA 71 is a systemic, non-selective, post-emergence herbicide containing Ammonium Salt of Glyphosate 71% SG. It is designed for weed management and is specified on the label for controlling annual, perennial, broadleaf and grassy weeds in tea and non-crop areas. The formulation works through foliar application and translocation within the weed plant. For best results, follow the manufacturer's label instructions regarding application, dilution, target area and safety precautions

about_item: SERA 71 – GLYPHOSATE 71% SG SERA 71 में Ammonium Salt of Glyphosate 71% SG है और यह एक systemic herbicide है। पैकेट पर दिए label के अनुसार annual, perennial, broadleaf और grassy weeds के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
SILSTICK – SILICON SURFACTANT Silstick एक non-ionic spray adjuvant है, जिसे product label के अनुसार spraying में wetting, spreading और penetrating में सहायता के लिए formulated किया गया है।
AMMONIUM SALT OF GLYPHOSATE 71% SG SERA 71 contains Ammonium Salt of Glyphosate 71% SG and is formulated as a systemic herbicide for weed management
BROAD-SPECTRUM WEED CONTROL Suitable for controlling a range of annual, perennial, broadleaf and grassy weeds as specified on the product label.
